title: Evening Hinduism Fair Game On Chatgpt But Not Islam And Christianity
body: The latest in Twitter Files reveals suppression of a tweet in connection with Covid-19 after it was flagged by Pfizer board member. With $10.8 billion, Bengaluru is the top city in terms of startup funding in 2022. An Indian-American aerospace expert has been appointed as NASA's new chief technologist. A woman and child were killed after an under-construction Bengaluru Metro pillar came crashing down.
